description: Audit one public web page for visibility in Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity. Fetches the page as the AI search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) to catch robots.txt, CDN and firewall blocks, checks how much content exists without JavaScript, and scores extractability and trust signals. Returns the score, every check's result and a fix pack: the fixes in priority order with where each lives in a codebase and a command to verify it. Takes 10–30 seconds.

url.description: The page to audit, e.g. https://example.com/pricing
